hero.heading:
Toward artificial general
intelligence with free will.
hero.body: Pardes is developing BiNet, a biologically-plausible neural network that does not depend on backpropagation. By giving any moving body a “brain,” we aim to expand what AI can do in the physical world.
narrative: A probabilistic learning process that does not rely on gradient computation, aiming for intelligence that does not require massive training data or GPU clusters.
Designed so that new experiences are less likely to overwrite existing knowledge, enabling intelligence that keeps learning in the field.
Aiming for real-time learning and adaptation with the limited compute available on the robot itself, without assuming a constant cloud connection.

hero.heading:
Tackling the 3 walls blocking
robotics and AI adoption
hero.body: Pardes is addressing structural challenges in conventional deep learning through a biologically-plausible learning principle.

items.title: The wall of learning cost
items.body: Conventional deep learning requires large amounts of training data and compute, making adoption too costly for many use cases.

items.title: The wall of hardware
items.body: Dependence on GPUs leads to high power consumption and cost, making it difficult to deploy on edge devices and mobile robots.

items.title: Rigidity of intelligence
items.body: Once trained, models struggle to adapt in real time to changes in their environment, often requiring retraining or redesign for each new site.

coreTech.heading: What is BiNet?
coreTech.body: BiNet is a biologically-plausible neural network technology that does not use backpropagation (BP). By combining a learning mechanism modeled on neurotransmitter activity with temporal accumulation/smoothing of information and learning via probabilistic convergence, it realizes a learning principle different from conventional AI.

definition.heading: What is BiNet?
definition.body: BiNet is a biologically-plausible neural network technology developed by Pardes Inc. that does not use backpropagation. Through a learning mechanism modeled on neurotransmitter activity, it implements intelligence on principles different from conventional deep learning.

items.title: Temporal accumulation & smoothing
items.body: Accumulates and smooths incoming information over time, resulting in learning that is less affected by momentary noise.

items.title: Modeling neurotransmitter activity
items.body: A mechanism modeled on the activity of neurotransmitters in living organisms, achieving biologically-plausible information processing.

items.title: Learning via probabilistic convergence
items.body: Learning proceeds through a probabilistic convergence process, rather than gradient-based backpropagation.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Pardes Inc. (“we,” “our,” or “the Company”) handles personal information collected through our contact form in accordance with the following policy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect the name, company/affiliation, email address, purpose of inquiry, and message you provide through our contact form.

sections.title: Purpose of Use
sections.body: The information we collect is used solely to respond to your inquiry and to communicate with you regarding PoC partnerships or career applications, and is not used for any other purpose.

sections.title: Retention Period
sections.body: We retain personal information for up to one year for the purpose of responding to inquiries, after which it is promptly deleted.

sections.title: Third-Party Disclosure & Processors
sections.body: We use an email delivery service (Resend) to respond to inquiries, and Cloudflare Turnstile for spam protection. As part of using these services, necessary information may be transmitted to these service providers.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.body: We use Google Analytics 4 to analyze site usage for the purpose of improving our services.

sections.title: Requests for Disclosure or Deletion
sections.body: If you wish to request disclosure, correction, or deletion of your personal information, please contact us via our contact form.
